paragraphs: Zone & Co’s ERP‑native AI platform transforms finance teams by embedding automation directly into Oracle NetSuite. I have built similar agentic solutions that run inside existing ecosystems, ensuring seamless integration and rapid deployment.
I deployed the agent as a Docker container on AWS Lambda using Lambda Web Adapter, ECR image pipelines, IAM execution roles and least‑privilege policies, delivering a fully serverless workflow.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python (FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI) for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client, presented in a live stakeholder demo.

I have not used Azure yet, but I am eager to bring my cloud‑agnostic deployment experience to your team. Would you be open to a brief call where I can walk you through my Lambda and MCP prototypes and discuss how they could accelerate your NetSuite AI initiatives?
